_comment: Deployed as a Vapi Squad — the documented mechanism for connecting multiple assistants with conditional call transfers. 'from'/'to' reference agent 'name' fields in config/agents/*.json. deploy.js resolves these into Vapi assistantDestinations after creating each assistant.
